name: @vip/service-evidence
description: Evidence service (Phase 2, P2-2 G-4) — the Evidence bounded context (22 §11, 23 §evidence, 12-EVIDENCE-MANAGEMENT): registers snapshots & video clips as immutable, traceable evidence with a canonical manifest, version-safe overlay metadata, an append-only hash-chained chain-of-custody, retention/legal-hold, and signed-URL-only secure retrieval. Storage is provider-abstracted (@vip/storage ObjectStore: local-fs/MinIO/S3), tenant-isolated (@vip/tenancy). Consumes incident.raised to auto-register evidence from EventEnvelope.evidenceRefs; never depends on any AI engine.
